title: NaijaDocs
shortDesc: NaijaDocs AI is a professional, mobile-first web application designed specifically for the Nigerian market. It empowers entrepreneurs, NGOs, and businesses to instantly generate formal, government-standard documents—such as Business Plans for BoI/GEEP grants, Tenancy Agreements for Lagos/Abuja, and CAC-compliant NGO Constitutions, using advanced AI
